<template>
  <rect
  :width="width"
  :height="height"
  :style="`fill:red`"
  ></rect>
</template>

<script>
// @ is an alias to /src
import HelloWorld from '@/components/HelloWorld.vue'

const getWidth = () => document.getElementById("app").clientWidth;
const getHeight = () => document.getElementById("app").clientHeight;

export default {
  name: 'HomeView',
  components: {
    HelloWorld
  },
  data () {
    return {
      width: getWidth(),
      height: getHeight(),
    }
  },
}
</script>
